about: Pick-wave zones in WALK ORDER (the pick path). A bin joins the first zone whose `bins` lists it exactly; otherwise the zone whose `prefix` (or any of `prefixes`) matches the text before the first dash and whose `bays` range (if given) contains the number after it. Unmatched bins go to the catchAll zone. `exclude` bins are never picked from. lastResort zones are used only when no other bin holds the stock, in walk order, and the slip flags them with the zone label. `display` is the order zones are listed on the page (walk order when absent).
